name: @devup-ui/bun-plugin
description: Zero Config, Zero FOUC, Zero Runtime, CSS in JS Preprocessor for Bun
author: devfive

scripts.build: tsc && bun build --target node src/index.cjs.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --packages external && bun build --target node src/index.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --packages external && bun build --target node src/register.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/register.cjs --format cjs --packages external && bun build --target node src/register.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/register.mjs --format esm --packages external
